dataList.content: L'Inamovible will enter and leave the Changing Room in intervals.
Attacking L'Inamovible while she is in the Changing Room will increase her aggressiveness.

Sous Chef gains "Chopped Ingredients" from units she kills. These are consumed at the end of the turn, granting her stacks of "Eat yummies and perk up, you hear?".

The more she gets the stacks, the stronger and more frequent will her powerful move, "My signature knife work, you hear?", become.
Leather Wallets are not an exception when it comes to Sous Chef's ingredient-gathering. You cannot stop her culinary activity by playing defensively.

When Sous Chef fails to kill any targets, she will get stacks of "Got an appetite, you hear?". At 3 stacks, she will use another powerful Skill. It may be a good idea to let her continue cooking every once in a while.
Sometimes, Clashing against the Floor Manager's certain skill with your Attack Skills could be a bad idea.

Be too wary and let yourself accumulate 10 stacks of "Guarded Caution", and you will risk inviting the Floor Manager's powerful Skill.
Pay attention so that "Guarded Caution" does not reach 10 stacks. You may also choose to lose a Clash against a certain Skill to remove the stacks.
If you have "Gratitude for Listening", perhaps you will want to stay your attacks for a short while.
The Crimson God [Inchoate Life]'s Lifecord houses immense power. It may be a good idea to prioritize destroying it before all else.
Let a Sinner with high HP deal with the Crimson God [Inchoate Life]'s powerful Skill.

If your units are gaining too many "Baptism [Crimson]" Stacks, use Defense Skills to remove them. At max Stack, it causes a great deal of Bleed Damage, and the defeated unit will become an enemy—"Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God [Inchoate Life]."

If you are hit by the "Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!" Skill while you have accumulated many stacks of Naildle, you will enter the "Taxidermized" state and receive devastating damage.
If there are surviving Needlekins in the same turn as when the King of Needleworks uses a powerful Skill, they will enhance that Skill's damage.
